en: The Therāpadāna: The Chapter on the Golden Couch (Suvaṇṇabibbohanavagga) 8. The Apadāna of the Elder Āluvadāyaka [Verse 1] I gave alms-food to the Buddha, the Teacher, the Great Sage, who was wandering for alms in the city of Benares. [Verse 2] Because of that gift of alms-food, I was reborn in heaven; having enjoyed celestial bliss there, I have now attained final Nibbāna. [Verse 3] For eighty-four thousand aeons I dwelt in heaven; having passed through those aeons, I have now attained final Nibbāna. [Verse 4] In this world, I am known as Āluvadāyaka; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 5] My body is golden-hued, beautiful to behold; my face is like the full moon, and my eyes are like blue lotuses. [Verse 6] I am free from all defilements, liberated from all bonds; having severed the stream of existence, I have crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra. [Verse 7] Just as a lotus is not soiled by water, so too am I undefiled by the world; I have reached the further shore and stand upon dry land. [Verse 8] I have no fear of the King of Death; I have transcended birth and old age;

I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 9] I have seen the Buddha, the Teacher, the Great Sage; I have heard his Dhamma, which leads to the cessation of suffering. [Verse 10] Having practiced the holy life under the Buddha, the Teacher, I have attained the fruit of Arhatship, the highest goal. [Verse 11] I pay homage to the Buddha, the Teacher, the Great Sage; I pay homage to the Dhamma, which leads to the cessation of suffering. [Verse 12] I pay homage to the Saṅgha, the assembly of the noble ones; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 13] I have reached the end of suffering, the final goal; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 14] I am a field of merit for the world, worthy of offerings and hospitality; I am a supreme vessel for the gifts of the faithful. [Verse 15] I am a refuge for the world, a protector for those who wander; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 16] I have reached the end of all conditioned things; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 17] I have reached the end of all suffering; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 18] I have reached the end of all existence; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 19] I have reached the end of all becoming; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 20] I have reached the end of all clinging; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 21] I have reached the end of all craving; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 22] I have reached the end of all ignorance; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 23] I have reached the end of all views; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 24] I have reached the end of all conceit; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 25] I have reached the end of all pride; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 26] I have reached the end of all delusion; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 27] I have reached the end of all fetters; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 28] I have reached the end of all bonds; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 29] I have reached the end of all obstacles; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 30] I have reached the end of all hindrances; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 31] I have reached the end of all taints; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 32] I have reached the end of all effluents; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 33] I have reached the end of all outflows; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 34] I have reached the end of all stains; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 35] I have reached the end of all impurities; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 36] I have reached the end of all corruptions; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 37] I have reached the end of all defilements; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 38] I have reached the end of all attachments; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 39] I have reached the end of all desires; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 40] I have reached the end of all lust; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 41] I have reached the end of all hatred; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 42] I have reached the end of all delusion; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 43] I have reached the end of all greed; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 44] I have reached the end of all anger; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 45] I have reached the end of all malice; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 46] I have reached the end of all envy; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 47] I have reached the end of all stinginess; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 48] I have reached the end of all hypocrisy;

I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 49] I have reached the end of all deceit; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 50] I have reached the end of all fraud; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 51] I have reached the end of all arrogance; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 52] I have reached the end of all vanity; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 53] I have reached the end of all conceit; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 54] I have reached the end of all pride; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 55] I have reached the end of all delusion; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 56] I have reached the end of all ignorance; I have reached the state of peace, the coolness, the unconditioned. [Verse 57
there is the beautiful Mahāsindhu river;
there I saw one who is free from passion.”
Having seen him, who was of great splendor and beautiful to behold,
and who was devoted to supreme tranquility,
my mind was filled with wonder.
With my own hands, full of faith, I gave him a yam;
Because I gave that fruit back then,
I do not know a state of misery;
this is the fruit of that *āluva* tree.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Āluvadāyaka spoke these verses.
This is the eighth legend of the elder Āluvadāyaka.
